situations.title: 노출 환경·시간 문진
situations.tagline: I was out in the sun all day at the festival and now I feel awful.
situations.brief: 더위·추위 노출의 경위와 시간을 체계적으로 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: How long were you out in the heat, and were you drinking water?
When did you start feeling dizzy or sick?
Were you able to find any shade or rest?

situations.title: 경증 열탈진 사정
situations.tagline: I got really sweaty and lightheaded, but I think I'm okay now.
situations.brief: 발한·어지럼을 사정하고 수분 보충과 냉각을 시행·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Sweating and feeling faint are signs of heat exhaustion.
We're cooling you down and giving you fluids to drink.
Tell me if you get confused or stop sweating — that's more serious.

situations.title: 경증 저체온 초기
situations.tagline: I got caught in the cold rain and I can't stop shivering.
situations.brief: 떨림 등 초기 저체온을 사정하고 보온 조치를 시행·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The shivering means your body is trying to warm itself.
We're getting you out of these wet clothes and into warm blankets.
How long were you out in the cold and wet?

situations.title: 일광화상 처치 설명
situations.tagline: My shoulders are bright red and burning — I fell asleep at the beach.
situations.brief: 냉각·수분·통증 조절 등 일광화상 처치를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll cool the skin and give you something for the pain.
Drink plenty of water, since sunburn can dry you out.
Watch for blisters or a fever, and don't pop any blisters.

situations.title: 탈수 수분보충 교육
situations.tagline: I've had diarrhea for two days and I feel so weak and thirsty.
situations.brief: 탈수 정도를 사정하고 경구·정맥 수분보충을 판단·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Since you're keeping fluids down, let's start with drinking these.
If you can't drink enough, we'll give you fluids through an IV.
Small frequent sips work better than gulping a lot at once.

situations.title: 열사병
situations.tagline: Where… where am I? It's so hot… I can't think…
situations.brief: 중심체온 상승과 의식변화를 인지하고 적극적 냉각을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Your body temperature is dangerously high and we're cooling you fast.
We're putting cool packs and misting you to bring it down.
Can you tell me your name and where you are right now?

situations.title: 중등도 저체온
situations.tagline: He stopped shivering and he's getting really slow and sleepy.
situations.brief: 떨림 소실·서맥을 사정하고 능동 재가온을 시행·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: When shivering stops, the cold has gone deeper — this is serious.
We're actively warming him with heated blankets and warm fluids.
We'll move him gently to avoid stressing his heart.

situations.title: 동상 손발
situations.tagline: My fingers were numb and white, now they're throbbing as they warm up.
situations.brief: 재가온을 시행하고 수포·조직 상태를 사정·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We're rewarming your fingers in warm water, and the throbbing is expected.
Don't rub them — that can damage the tissue more.
We'll watch for blisters and check how the color returns.

situations.title: 노인 여름 탈수 혼돈
situations.tagline: Grandma's been confused since the heat wave, and barely eating or drinking.
situations.brief: 의식변화와 전해질 이상 가능성을 사정하고 재수화를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Dehydration in the heat can cause confusion in older adults.
We'll check her electrolytes and rehydrate her carefully.
Has she been urinating less or feeling dizzy when standing?

situations.title: 운동성 열손상 선수
situations.tagline: I collapsed during the race — I'm cramping everywhere and burning up.
situations.brief: 중심체온을 확인하고 냉수 침수 등 적극 냉각을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: We're checking your core temperature with a special probe.
We're cooling you with an ice-water immersion to bring it down fast.
How long were you running, and when did the cramps start?

situations.title: 저체온+음주 노숙
situations.tagline: I was just sleeping outside… I'm fine, I don't need all this fuss.
situations.brief: 사회적 요인을 고려하며 재가온과 안전을 비판단적으로 접근하세요.
keyPhrases: You're colder than you feel, so let's get you warm and safe.
I'm not judging you — I just want to take good care of you.
When did you last eat or have something to drink?

situations.title: 익수 후 저체온
situations.tagline: He fell through the ice — we pulled him out but he's freezing and coughing.
situations.brief: 흡인 위험과 호흡을 감시하며 저체온 재가온을 병행하세요.
keyPhrases: We're watching his breathing closely since water can affect the lungs.
At the same time we're warming his body core.
How long was he in the water, and did he go under?

situations.title: 열경련 전해질
situations.tagline: My legs keep cramping up hard after working the whole shift in the heat.
situations.brief: 나트륨 등 전해질 보충을 설명하고 재발 예방을 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Heat cramps often come from losing salt when you sweat a lot.
We'll give you fluids with electrolytes to replace what you lost.
Next time, take breaks and drink electrolyte drinks, not just water.

situations.title: 고산/환경 노출 언어장벽
situations.tagline: He hiked high up and now has a bad headache and can't breathe well.
situations.brief: 통역을 활용해 노출 경위를 확인하고 처치를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Through the interpreter — how high did he climb and how fast?
When did the headache and shortness of breath start?
We're giving oxygen and will explain each step through the interpreter.
goals: 통역을 통해 노출 경위를 정확히 확인한다

situations.title: 약물 유발 고체온 감별
situations.tagline: I started a new medication and now I'm burning up and stiff — is it the heat?
situations.brief: 환경성과 약물성 고체온을 감별하기 위해 병력을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The stiffness makes me wonder if a medication is causing this, not just heat.
What new medications did you start, and when?
We'll cool you down while we figure out the exact cause.

situations.title: 열사병 다장기부전
situations.tagline: He was down in the heat for hours before we found him.
situations.brief: 냉각과 함께 횡문근·DIC 등 다장기부전을 사정하고 팀에 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Core temp is critically high with signs of organ injury and clotting problems.
We're aggressively cooling and checking for muscle breakdown and DIC.
Heat stroke with multi-organ failure — I need labs and blood products ready.

situations.title: 심부저체온 심정지
situations.tagline: He's pulseless and ice-cold — we keep working until he's warm.
situations.brief: 재가온을 지속하며 소생술을 시행하고 ECMO 고려를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He's not dead until he's warm and dead — keep resuscitating.
Continue compressions while we actively rewarm the core.
Deep hypothermic arrest — let's activate the ECMO team now.

situations.title: 중증 동상 구획증후군
situations.tagline: My foot is so swollen and tight after warming — the pain is unbearable now.
situations.brief: 재관류 후 구획증후군을 사정하고 외과 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The tightness and severe pain worry me about pressure building in your foot.
We're checking the circulation and calling surgery to assess you.
Tell me if the numbness or pain gets worse — that's important.

situations.title: 횡문근융해 신부전
situations.tagline: My urine is dark like tea and my muscles ache everywhere after being out in the heat.
situations.brief: CK·소변량을 감시하고 적극적 수액 요법을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Dark urine with muscle aches can mean your muscles are breaking down.
We're giving lots of fluids to protect your kidneys.
We'll watch your urine output closely and check a muscle enzyme called CK.

situations.title: 저체온 부정맥 급변
situations.tagline: His heart rhythm just went haywire while we were moving him.
situations.brief: 조작을 최소화하며 부정맥을 감시하고 재가온을 지속하세요.
keyPhrases: Cold hearts are irritable — handle him as gently as possible.
Keep rewarming while we watch this rhythm closely.
Avoid unnecessary movement so we don't trigger a worse arrhythmia.

situations.title: 환경 위기 이송 인계
situations.tagline: Bringing in a hyperthermic patient — temp's been climbing the whole transport.
situations.brief: 노출 경위와 체온 추이를 포함해 받는 팀에 명확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Found down in a hot warehouse, unknown duration.
Core temp was forty-one on scene and hasn't come down much.
We started cooling and two large-bore IVs en route.
